name: Banca Sistema S.p.A.
summary: Banca Sistema S.p.A. provides banking services to individuals, businesses, and professionals in Italy. It offers current accounts, securities accounts, and online deposit accounts; credits, subsidies, debt management and collection, and factoring, as well as securitization services and minibond issuances; and advance, personal loans, business financing and leasing, mortgages, and salary and pension assignment. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Milan, Italy. Banca Sistema S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of Banca CF+ S.p.A.
